name: Sentinel-2 L2A MGRS-36RUV window (2023-01-18)
what_it_is: Real Copernicus Sentinel-2 MSI Level-2A surface-reflectance window: 2048x2048 px at 10 m (20.5 km), 4 bands (B02 blue, B03 green, B04 red, B08 nir), uint16 DN, EPSG:32636, nodata=0. Cut from the SAME pixel window as s2_s2b-36ruv-20230806-0-l2a_2048px.tif, so the two scenes share one CRS, affine transform and shape.
not_good_for: cloud-covered pixels are not masked (scene-wide cloud is 0.061131); no atmospheric correction beyond L2A
notes: Reflectance = DN/10000 (BOA_ADD_OFFSET 0, verified empirically -- see docs/PHASE2.md). Band order is blue, green, red, nir -- NOT wavelength order. Acquired by the same sensor and processing level as the reference scene to keep the comparison like-for-like.
